description: Held-out sentences for the Stage 7 evaluation, written on 2026-10-26 after the classifier, word lists, and thresholds were frozen, and not looked at with the classifier before they were final. Labels follow docs/intent-eval.md. Measured ONCE (docs/benchmarks.md); changing the classifier or rules after seeing the result means this set is no longer held out. For organic_rank_tracking items, 'task' is the structured request the user means (the sentence may leave some of it out). One annotator (the project author).
